title: Pyramid Storm
description: 3-round strength-cardio circuit followed by a jump lunge pyramid across 7 explosive steps

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Goblet squat (no weight)
exercises.instructions: Hands in front of the chest, go deep

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Like a hip thrust but lying down, drive the hips toward the ceiling

exercises.name: Shoulder taps plank
exercises.instructions: In a high plank, tap the opposite shoulder alternating sides

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
